note: Per-side hero illustrations for the comparison cards. WebP, ~1000px long edge. Convention: <cardId>__a.webp / <cardId>__b.webp, a/b matching side order in comparison-cards.ts. All 14 cards fully illustrated (28 images).
rendering: fullFrameSides are edge-to-edge 4:3 scenes with a filled oceanic backdrop (safe to use object-fit:cover + rounded-corner clipping, since each is exactly 4:3 so cover never crops). Every other side is a transparent cut-out on the app surface and must stay object-fit:contain. Keeping contain everywhere is also fine — it renders both correctly.
